arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

sheets = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, sheet in sheets.items():
    print('Sheet:', name)
    print(sheet.to_string())
    print('---')

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[10:22, :3].copy()
exp.columns = ['category', 'item', 'amount']
print(exp.to_string())
print('Amount dtype:', exp['amount'].dtype)
print('Total expenses:', exp['amount'].sum())

# Per-category subtotals
print(exp.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().to_string())
